daso_candidate_pool: New32B fitted proposals plus BF16/plain INT8/SQ INT8/FP8 calibration incumbents
daso_selection: Minimum new-GPU additive profile cost among candidates passing the validation guard; BF16 remains eligible
daso_solver: Two stages: minimum additive latency within predicted quality budget, then minimum predicted quality within optimum latency +1e-7 ms
hawq_primary_trace: P16/B4/S256, signed, all448 raw projection blocks
hawq_latency_cap: Selected DASO point additive latency; relax to feasible minimum only with explicit flag
hawq_tie_break: Minimum additive latency within normalized signed-Hessian optimum +1e-8
scope: Frozen before any DASO/HAWQ validation or test closure. Uniforms are calibration/selection anchors, not additional formal baseline rows. Exact optimization applies only to the additive proxy.

speed_aggregation.within_case: Median of ten timed iterations, excluding five warmups
speed_aggregation.within_round_reference: Arithmetic mean of same-scenario BF16 start/end medians
speed_aggregation.across_rounds: Arithmetic mean of three per-round normalized speedup ratios; show min/max and three raw case medians
speed_aggregation.variation_flag: Retain all complete rounds. Flag when (max-min)/mean exceeds 0.05 for case E2E or BF16 bracket drift abs(end-start)/mean exceeds 0.05 in any round.
speed_aggregation.prefill_metric: Prefill E2E with one output token; TTFT also retained.
speed_aggregation.memory: Report Torch peak allocated separately from sampled NVML allocation minus empirical idle footprint, persistent phase cache, and process peak RSS.
